title: Managed Database: personal correction authorization — assessment outcome
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database personal correction authorization uses the following assessment outcome basis. Round the positive remaining overcharge half-up to two USD decimals as the exact amount the customer personally authorizes; zero overcharge requires no new request.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical input: the positive remaining overcharge is USD 12.345. Decimal half-up at two places produces a personal authorization amount of USD 12.35. At a hypothetical zero remaining overcharge, there is no new request.
